messages.subject: RHIPE 0.7
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

The param argument now writes the parameters to a temp file in HDFS
(as specified in rhoptions()$HADOOP.TMP.FOLDER )
Also fixed a bug for 'orderby'.

Download: https://github.com/downloads/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/Rhipe_0.70.tar.gz

Regards
Saptarshi

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I can pass a variable into a rhmap or into a rhreduce using .param.
But what if inside the mapred the value of the variable changes. How can I get the changed value back into my program?

Let me show a simple example to demonstrate what I mean.

Consider the code:

test.MR <-function (ifolder, tempfolder) {
    c=list(NULL)
    print(c)
    m <- rhmap({
                rhcollect(k, 2*r)
                c=5
            })

    z <- rhwatch(rhmr(map=m
                    ,ifolder=ifolder
                    ,ofolder=tempfolder
                    ,param=list(c=c)
                    ,inout=c("sequence", "sequence")
                    ,mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=1)
            ))
    print(c)
}

I would like to print:
NULL
5

instead of printing:
NULL
NULL

Thanks
Rui

messages.subject: RHIPE from desktop/laptop
messages.body_plain:
1. I use CDH Hadoop and Hbase
2. I copied the mozilla conf folder and edited
   a) for OS X i removed the JAVA_HOME (despite this not being set in
my bashrc. The same worked for
   Ubuntu, though the user did have JAVA_HOME) from hadoop-env.sh
   b) Also, edited HADOOP_CLASSPTATH and HBASE_HOME in hadoop-env.sh
to include HBASE classes. This
   is not required if you never use HBASE
3. The rhipe initialization had this extra bit

#+begin_src R
if(Sys.getenv("HOSTNAME")==""){
  Sys.setenv(
             "HADOOP"          =sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/",Sys.getenv("HOME"))
             ,"HADOOP_HOME"
=sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/",Sys.getenv("HOME"))
             ,"HADOOP_LIB"
=sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/lib/",Sys.getenv("HOME"))
             ,"HADOOP_CONF_DIR"
=sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/conf.mango",Sys.getenv("HOME")))
}
#+end_src

4. Whenever i run hadoop, it uses the ip address and ports from the
configuration folder specified
   in HADOOP\_CONF\_DIR

The net result is that i can use RHIPE from my laptop /without/ SSHing
into a remote server. If I
close my laptop all i need to is call rhinit (and it's associate
stuff) once again.

All i do is
source("~/mz/rhipe.prefix.R")

the same code runs on Redhat linux box, as on Mac box and i guess Ubuntu too.

For you reference

1. My RHIPE initialization code (i need this for my cluster setup, you
might not need anything below (1)
#+begin_src R
if(Sys.getenv("HOSTNAME")==""){
  Sys.setenv(
             "HADOOP"          =sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/",Sys.getenv("HOME"))
             ,"HADOOP_HOME"
=sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/",Sys.getenv("HOME"))
             ,"HADOOP_LIB"
=sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/lib/",Sys.getenv("HOME"))
             ,"HADOOP_CONF_DIR"
=sprintf("%s/workmoz/hadoop/conf",Sys.getenv("HOME")))
}

USER <- "sguha"
library(Rhipe)
rhinit()
options(width=200)
options(java.parameters="-Xrs")
## (1)
m <- rhoptions()$mropts
m$mapred.output.compress <- 'true'
m$mapreduce.map.maxattempts = 1
m$mapred.reduce.tasks = 50
m$R_HOME              = "./Rfolder-test/Rdist/R"
m$R_HOME_DIR          = "./Rfolder-test/Rdist/R"
m$R_SHARE_DIR         = "./Rfolder-test/Rdist/R/share"
m$R_INCLUDE_DIR       = "./Rfolder-test/Rdist/R/include"
m$R_DOC_DIR           = "./Rfolder-test/Rdist/R/doc"

m$PATH            = "./Rfolder-test/Rdist/R/bin:./Rfolder-test/Rdist:$PATH"
m$LD_LIBRARY_PATH = "./Rfolder-test/Rdist:./Rfolder-test/Rdist/R/lib:/usr/lib64"
## java fix
currentLD <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("LD_LIBRARY_PATH"),":")[[1]]
currentLD <- paste(currentLD[!grepl(USER, currentLD)],collapse=":")
m$LD_LIBRARY_PATH = paste(c(currentLD,m$LD_LIBRARY_PATH),collapse=":")

rhoptions(runner="./Rfolder-test/Rdist/RhipeMapReduce --silent --vanilla")
rhoptions(zips=sprintf("/user/%s/Rfolder-test.tar.gz",USER)
          ,HADOOP.TMP.FOLDER=sprintf("/user/%s/tmp/",USER)
          ,mropts=m
          )
#rhclean()
rm(m);rm(currentLD)
summer <- Rhipe::rhoptions()$templates$scalarsummer
#+end_src
